AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

ChainId.description: Unique identifier of the chain. Required when using [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property), ignored otherwise.

MotherCompanyId.description: Unique identifier of the mother company.

InvoicingEmail.description: Email for issuing invoices to the company.

WebsiteUrl.description: The website url of the company.

InvoiceDueInterval.description: The maximum time, when the invoice has to be be paid in ISO 8601 duration format.

CreditRating.title: Credit rating parameters
CreditRating.description: Credit rating to define creditworthiness of the company.

Department.description: The internal segmentation of a company, e.g. sales department.

DunsNumber.description: The Dun & Bradstreet unique 9-digit DUNS number.

ReferenceIdentifier.description: External system identifier - custom identifier used by an external system such as an external database.

AdditionalTaxIdentifier.description: Additional tax identifer of the company.

Contact.description: Other contact details, such as telephone, email or similar.

Identifier.description: Fiscal or legal identifier of the company.

TaxIdentifier.description: Tax identification number of the company.

ExternalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the company from external system.
